spec_notes: Verified in env: @dsnp/parquetjs exports { ParquetSchema, ParquetWriter, ... } (also has default). Use `const pkg = (await import('@dsnp/parquetjs')).default || mod` pattern. All CSV columns are written as UTF8 string type — no type inference; numbers stay strings. Naive comma split: no quoted-field/escape handling (multi-comma fields break); sufficient for simple fixtures. ParquetWriter.openFile(schema, path) returns a promise; await it, then await writer.appendRow(row) per row and writer.close(). Output verified with PAR1 magic, 593 bytes for 2-row fixture. Reference kernel had a broken regex (literal newline in split pattern) and un-awaited async IIFEs — do not copy those; the code_body here is fully awaited.
